pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against opening secondary or tertiary positions within 2 points of an existing trade; all pyramiding must require a confirmed 1.5 ATR continuation break.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: No XAUUSD order execution allowed during periods where the 5-minute ATR exceeds 3.5 times the 20-period moving average, preventing entry into high-impact expansion wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing sentinel harvest immediately when floating profit hits +$15.00 to lock in asymmetric gains and prevent profit evaporation.
